ينتزعا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَزِعَا (yantaziʕā) /jan.ta.zi.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# يُنْتَزَعَا (yuntazaʕā) /jun.ta.za.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
